page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top ("GEOGRAPH. LIB. I.") with page number "18" at top left. Top: a block of verse (italic, 4 lines) at full width. Below it a centred heading "Flumina Galliæ celebriora." Then the main verse in two parts: a left margin of marginal notes (names of rivers, references) and the verse lines of the poem in the text column to their right. Lower left margin notes continue beside the last lines. Catchword/signature at bottom right "Vasco-" as a catchword-like word at the foot right.

main_text.l: Vaniloquum, Celtæ, genus, ac mutabile mentis,
Respectare domos, mærebant cæde sine vlla
Inter tela siti Manortis hebescere dextras.
main_text.head: Flumina Galliæ celebriora.
main_text.p: Idem ibid. Arar. Rhodanus. Garumna. Carnuti pop. Liger fl. Ausón. Epist. dyl. 10. Axona fl. Matrona fl. Carantonus fluuius. Duras fl. Tarnes fl. Mosella fluuius, eiusque descriptio. Aturrus fl.Testis Arar, Rhodanúsque celer, magnúsque Garumna, Carnuti & Flaui, cærula lympha Liger. Non tibi se Liger anteferet, non Axona præceps, Matronanon Gallos, Belgósque interfita fines, Santonico refluus non ipse Carantonus æstu. Concedes gelido Duras de monte volutus Amnis: & auriferum postponet Gallia Tarnem. Insanúmque ruens per saxa rotantia late In mare purpureum, domina tamen ante Mosella Numine adorato, Tarbellius ibit Aturrus. Corniger extremas celebrande Mosella per oras, Nec solis celebrande locis, vbi fonte supremo Exeris auratum taurina frontis honorem: Quaq; trahis placidos sinuosa per arua meatus: Vel quà Germanis sub portubus oftia soluis: Si quis honos tenui volet aspirare Camena, Perdere si quis in his dignabitur otia musis, Ibis in ora hominum, lætóque fouebere cantu. Te fontes, vnique lacus, te cærula nascent Flumina: te veteres pagorum gloria, luci, Druna fl. Druentia fl.Te Druna te sparsis incerta Druentia ripis, Alpinique colent fluuij, duplicémque per vrbem Rhodanus fluuius diuidit Arelate oppidum. Garumna fl.Qui meat, & dextra Rhodanus dat nomina ripa. Te stagnis ego cæruleis, magnúmque sonoris Amnibus, æquorea te commendabo Garumna.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are set in small italic and roman type and were read approximately; the verse lines are italic. The catchword "Vasco-" at the lower right is a partial word and is given as printed. Some letters in the verse are uncertain (e.g. "Quaq;", "Vel quà", "Perdere si"), and [?] was not added throughout due to print quality.
